Origin and meaning

Laura comes from Latin and means “laurel”.

About the name Laura

The poet Petrarch's muse, and the name of the writer Laura Ingalls Wilder.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Laura carries the meaning “laurel” and looks striking in brush strokes.
